title: Certificate-Type Charge on Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Reinstatement Refilings
content:
A refiling type charge is added to the refiling fee of a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) reinstatement refiling, which replaces a certificate whose SR-26 was transmitted for a cancellation of its since-reinstated backing term. It follows the certificate type, which fixes the kind of backing term the certificate rests on.

**Charge by certificate type**

- An Owner-Operator certificate on an Owner Auto Policy backing term adds 4.00.
- An Operator certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy backing term adds 2.00.
- An Owner certificate adds no refiling type charge.

**Examples (hypothetical)**

- **Owner-Operator.** A refiled FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate on an Owner Auto Policy term: 4.00.
- **Operator.** A refiled SR-22 Operator Certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy term: 2.00.
- **Owner.** A refiled SR-22 Owner Certificate: no type charge.
